description: PMH-T-D80 double-sided tape is a specially formulated sticky, PET film enforced pressure sensitive tape. It is designed for membrane terminations, detailing, patching of damaged membranes and penetrations.
whereToUse: The product can be used for PMH 3040/3040PLUS and PMH 6010 membranes' end lap termination or repair works
patching of damaged membranes and penetrations
end lap of membrane or the T-type overlapping part
notFor: It is not recommended to use the tape when temperature is lower than 5℃ as bonding strength of the tape may be affected
The temperature shall be maintained for 24 hours after the tape is installed
Make sure that substrate is clean & dry before using the tape
When applying tape on the membrane, the lapped areas shall be pressed hard to ensure a good bonding effect
storage: Stored in well-ventilated and dry places. The temperature shall be below 45°C. Stay away from direct sunlight, rain and high temperature. Do not directly stack one roll on top of another. Separate them with release liner to prevent sticking.
